bluetooth_confirm.title: Add {name}?
bluetooth_confirm.description: Home Assistant found an ANKO body scale ({name}) in Bluetooth range. Add it only if it is yours.

profile.title: First person
profile.description: Enter the details of a person who uses this scale. More people can be added later with Configure. Give a birth date or an age. Details drive the body-composition calculations.

data.birth_date: Birth date as YYYY-MM-DD (preferred over age)
data.age: Age in years (only if no birth date)
data.person_entity: Person entity (optional, skips this person when not home)
data.expected_weight_kg: Starting weight in kg (optional, helps recognise this person)

error.name_exists: Another person already has this name.
error.invalid_birth_date: Enter a past date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 1985-03-27.
error.birth_date_or_age: Enter a birth date or an age.

abort.no_devices_found: No ANKO body scales were found on the network.

delete_person.title: Delete a person
delete_person.description: Deleting a person removes their device and entities. Their history is not recoverable.

settings.title: Attribution settings
settings.description: A reading is assigned to the person whose expected weight is closest, if it is within the tolerance and at least the margin closer than the next person. Otherwise it waits as a pending measurement.

data.notify_service: Notify action for pending readings (for example notify.mobile_app_phone)

error.birth_date_or_age: Enter a birth date or an age.

assign_measurement.name: Assign measurement
assign_measurement.description: Assign a pending weigh-in to a person and publish their body metrics.

pending_id.name: Pending ID
pending_id.description: The pending_id from the pending sensor attributes or the anko_scale_pending_measurement event.

config_entry_id.name: Scale
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when more than one scale is configured.

discard_measurement.name: Discard measurement
discard_measurement.description: Discard a pending weigh-in, for example a guest. No profile is created.

config_entry_id.name: Scale
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when more than one scale is configured.

reassign_measurement.name: Reassign last measurement
reassign_measurement.description: Move the most recent attributed weigh-in to another person. The previous owner's values are restored.

person_id.name: Person ID
person_id.description: The person who should own the measurement.

config_entry_id.name: Scale
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when more than one scale is configured.

set_next_person.name: Set next person
set_next_person.description: Assign the next stable reading to this person, for up to 60 seconds. Leave the person empty to clear.

config_entry_id.name: Scale
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when more than one scale is configured.

reset_person_history.name: Reset person history
reset_person_history.description: Forget the stored weights used to recognise this person. Their starting weight, if set, is used again.

config_entry_id.name: Scale
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when more than one scale is configured.

capture_measurement.name: Capture measurement
capture_measurement.description: Wait for the next settled weigh-in and return its weight without assigning it to anyone. Nothing is added to a person's history. Fails if nothing arrives before the timeout.

config_entry_id.name: Scale
config_entry_id.description: Needed only when more than one scale is configured.

person.description: A weigh-in of {weight} kg did not match anyone on this scale. Add this person to recognise them from now on. The starting weight is the observed weight; change it if it was a one-off.
